title: Apply for an Active and Creative Kids voucher
summary: Parents, guardians, and carers who receive Family Tax Benefit can apply for an Active and Creative Kids voucher for eligible children.
intro:
Parents, guardians and carers receiving Family Tax Benefit can apply for an Active and Creative Kids voucher for each eligible child.

The $50 voucher is available twice a year to use towards sport, creative and cultural activities.

Voucher 2 – 2025: Available now

Voucher 1 – 2026: Available now

Note:
who_can_apply: Must be a parent, guardian, or carer receiving Family Tax Benefit.
The child must be aged between 4.5 and 18 years.
Must confirm eligibility for the Family Tax Benefit.
what_you_need: One proof of identity document for the parent, carer, or guardian (NSW Photo Cards cannot be used).
Medicare card details for the child.

faqs.q: Who can apply for the Active and Creative Kids voucher?
faqs.a: Parents, guardians, or carers who are receiving Family Tax Benefit can apply for the voucher for each eligible child. The child must be a NSW resident aged between 4.5 and 18 years.

faqs.q: What can the voucher be used for?
faqs.a: The voucher can be used for eligible activities such as dance, music, football (soccer), martial arts, craft, gymnastics, visual arts, painting, drawing, drama, tennis, rugby league, singing, basketball, languages, netball, yoga, creative writing, choreography, circus arts, and coding.

faqs.q: What is required to apply for the voucher?
faqs.a: You need a MyServiceNSW Account, proof of identity for the parent, carer, or guardian (NSW Photo Cards cannot be used), Medicare card details for your child, and your Centrelink Customer Reference Number (CRN).
